taste:
Doom Bar is a balanced amber ale with a slightly sweet flavour rather than a strongly bitter finish. Roasted malt is the clearest note, with a touch of dried fruit alongside it. The amber colour matches that malt-led character, while the clean, lightly bitter finish keeps the sweetness in check. It is a sensible choice if those are the flavours you tend to enjoy in an ale.

Served cold on draught, it has a smooth, refreshing mouthfeel. That combination makes it approachable for someone new to ale without ruling it out for a regular drinker. Alongside food, the source description particularly recommends roasted meats, including Sunday roast beef or a mixed grill.
